disclosure_cabinet.name: Disclosure Cabinet
disclosure_cabinet.description: A synthesis cabinet, 0.93 x 1.42 m on its plinth. One seeded linear congruential generator draws forty-eight numbers at build time and the cabinet reports one figure, 0.3958 — the fraction of them that landed at or above one half. The face is a FIXED rectangle, 0.78 x 0.90 m, and it is full at every rung of the axis: what changes is who is standing in it. At `oracle` the whole face is one lit sheet carrying the figure 0.70 m wide, unlabelled, with nothing to check it against. Each rung above appends one account band at the bottom — the eight-bin spread with its expected-count rule and its graduated scale, the forty-eight draws as two lanes of verdict-coloured bars struck through by the half rule, the recurrence with a, c and m printed, and the seed with thirty-two bit lamps — and every band above gives up height to pay for it. The figure is the same six characters in all five frames and is drawn four times smaller in the last one. Nothing moves; there is no _process, no interaction and no call to randf anywhere in the file.
interactions: read the figure, then look for anything that would let you disagree with it
count the eight bins against the expected line and notice the run is lumpy
find the ten-deep stretch on one side of the half rule in the record
read the seed off the lamps and know the whole cabinet could be rebuilt from it
disclosure_cabinet.capacity: SEE that the answer and the evidence are separable objects, and that they compete for the same wall: the more of its working a machine admits, the smaller its answer is drawn
disclosure_cabinet.qfep_connection: F is the recurrence — state = (state x a + c) mod m — identical and running at all five rungs, including the one that hides it. E is the account: spread, record, rule, seed, four irreducible kinds of evidence that cannot be recovered from each other, which is why the family needed a word for the choice at all. lambda is how much of it the institution is willing to print. The dark spot is `oracle`, and it is the deployed condition: 0.3958 arrives filling the whole face and there is no way to tell a fair generator from a broken one from a sample too short to ask.
disclosure_cabinet.relationships:
Synthesised from the `disclosure` family. Every source was read and each contributed a specific finding this cabinet exhibits rather than describes:

[[prng_crank_machine]] OWNS the ladder and the rank table. Its DISCLOSURE_RUNGS, DIST_BINS and REGISTER_BITS/REGISTER_ROW are read here by preload — the same link [[slot_machine]] makes at line 81 and nine artifacts make in total — so the vocabulary, the bin count and the register width cannot drift. It also contributed the finding that a declined seat has to be VISIBLY shut: its blanking plate was reworked in 2026-07-31 from a flush 8 mm patch to a proud accent-painted cover, because at capture resolution a dark rectangle and an unlit screen are the same picture and `tally` measured 1.96% from `ledger` on an axis whose whole claim at that step is whether the record is there. This cabinet takes that finding and departs from it on purpose — see dna.note.

[[random_number_book_page_1955]] found that the apparatus of record is paid for out of the data: 'each of those costs space, and space on a page is data', its `oracle` being the densest and least usable version of the page. That is the finding the whole cabinet is built out of — the face is a fixed rectangle and the account is taken out of the answer. Its line-number margin is here too, as the index rail the record's bars get narrower to make room for.

[[monte_carlo_dartboard]] wrote the family's sharpest sentence about `ledger`: at that rung 'the ratio on the screen is now a claim you can falsify with your eyes'. Its green-in / red-out verdict colouring is reused character for character, so a visitor who has met the dartboard reads this record without being told. Its `origin` — every mark keeping its hue and taking its draw index as brightness, so 'the darts stop being random and become entry 280 of a stream with an address' — is the one place on this cabinet where a rung improves a band it already showed instead of adding a new one.

[[shannon_entropy_meter]] contributed the ruler. Its `oracle` 'shows the reading and withholds the ruler — there is no way to tell 2.997 from 3.997 without the log2(N) it is measured against'. The spread band therefore arrives with a graduated left-edge scale and an accent rule at the expected count, and without that rule the eight bins would be a shape rather than a measurement.

[[coin_toss]] established that at `oracle` the OBJECT loses its markings too, not only the readout — the coins become blank slugs — and that `origin` means writing the initial conditions down, after Diaconis: 'the fairness starts to look like ignorance'. Its unlabelled figure is this cabinet's `oracle`: no header stencil at all, because a machine only begins naming its own organs once it has more than one.

[[hardware_entropy_decay]] carries the ladder on a claim about PROVENANCE — 'the observer is not separate from the system' — with the service bay bolted shut and stencilled SEALED at the bottom rung, and the transfer function printed at the top.

[[env_one]] built the seed as thirty-two lamps along the south edge and found the honest report for an unrecoverable origin: when randomize() was used the sockets stand EMPTY and struck through, because 'that world had an origin and nobody wrote it down, and it can never be visited again'. This cabinet's lamps are its lamps. The struck-through state is declined here, on the record — see dna.declines.

[[bias_visualizer]] is the family's precedent for departing from the legacy default: it ships at `origin` and falls back to `origin` rather than `works`, 'because a typo must not silently strip the caption off a wall two rooms already read'. This cabinet makes the same departure for the same reason and cites it in code.

It does NOT replace any of them. Eleven machines each asking this question once, in a room, one rung at a time, is the curriculum; this is the object for a room that wants the comparison.

dna.default: disclosure=origin. A synthesis has no shipped placements, so the default is a free design choice and there is no preservation duty to discharge; this is the strongest single reading rather than the emptiest. At `origin` all five bands are on the face at once and a visitor who never turns the knob can still read the whole vocabulary off the object top to bottom — figure, spread, record, rule, seed — which is what makes this a cabinet ABOUT disclosure rather than one more evasive machine. `oracle` is the more important frame and the worse default: placed blind it is a plaque with a number on it. The family's legacy `works` was not taken because this artifact has no legacy to preserve, and [[bias_visualizer]] already established that a member may depart from `works` when its own face argues otherwise. THE FALLBACK MOVES WITH THE DEFAULT: _rung() falls back to rank 4, not the family's 3, so an unreadable map token cannot quietly strip the seed, the rule and the record off a face somebody placed on purpose. Declared in LADDER order, matching the @export_enum and matching prng_crank_machine's own code — see dna.kin on the two orders already in the registry.
dna.was: synthesized from the `disclosure` family — 13 declaring entries, 230 placements, 11 of them on the shared five-word ladder. Nothing was promoted here; this artifact did not exist. It is the cross-member argument those eleven batches left in registry notes and code comments, built as a body.
dna.note:
THE ARGUMENT, and it is one no member of this family could make. Every one of the eleven can be only one rung at a time, which is right for a machine in a room and leaves one thing permanently unsaid: what the account COSTS. [[random_number_book_page_1955]] is the only member that came close, because a page has a fixed area and its folio, line numbers, running head and imprint are all paid for in digits — 'space on a page is data'. This cabinet generalises that past typography and makes it the construction rule. The face is 0.78 x 0.90 m at every rung and it is always full. Rung k shows bands 0..k, and the band heights are a table where every row sums to 0.90:

  oracle  FIGURE 0.90
  tally   FIGURE 0.48  SPREAD 0.42
  ledger  FIGURE 0.30  SPREAD 0.26  RECORD 0.34
  works   FIGURE 0.22  SPREAD 0.20  RECORD 0.28  RULE 0.20
  origin  FIGURE 0.16  SPREAD 0.16  RECORD 0.24  RULE 0.16  SEED 0.18

Read down the first column. The answer is not a headline the apparatus grows around; it is the thing the apparatus is taken out of. The figure is the same six characters — 0.3958 — in all five frames and is drawn 0.70 m wide at `oracle` and 0.17 m wide at `origin`. An exhibit that discloses everything has almost no room left to announce anything, and an exhibit that announces is using the whole wall.

THE FIGURE WIDTH HAD TO BE TABULATED, NOT DERIVED, and the reason is a fact about type rather than a preference. BakedText fits a string to 90% of the quad's width or 70% of its height, whichever binds first; six glyphs across 0.70 m are WIDTH-limited at every band height this face can offer, so shrinking the band alone would have moved all the apparatus and left the answer exactly the same size — the precise opposite of what this cabinet claims. FIGURE_W is therefore an explicit ladder, and the quad's height follows at 0.3694x width, which is where the fitter's two limits agree.

WHY THERE IS NO BLANK PLATE, and it is a deliberate departure from the family's own hard-won repair. [[prng_crank_machine]] and [[coin_toss]] cover a declined seat with a bolted plate standing 30 mm proud in the machine's own accent, after discovering that a flush dark patch and an unlit screen are one picture at 160 x 160 — 'a closure that cannot be seen is not a closure'. That is the correct repair for a machine with FIXED SEATS. This cabinet has none: at `oracle` the answer does not leave a hole where the account would be, it erases the hole, and nothing on the face says a record was ever possible. That is the more common and the more dishonest deployed condition, and it is the whole reason the bottom rung of this ladder needed a word — a sealed seat at least admits there is something behind it. The two idioms are not in conflict; they are two different lies, and the family now owns both.

THE FIGURE WAS NOT CHOSEN. draw_seed is 20260806, the promotion date, and 19 of 48 draws landed at or above one half, so the cabinet reports 0.3958. That is a visibly poor estimate of one half; the eight bins come out 8 7 7 7 4 3 4 8 against an expected 6; one side of the half rule runs ten deep at one point. All of it is honest small-sample behaviour, all of it is legible from `tally` up, and none of it is visible at `oracle`, where 0.3958 arrives with nothing beside it and you cannot tell a fair generator from a broken one from a sample too short to ask. Choosing a prettier seed would have been this artifact's own subject matter committed against itself.

WHY FORTY-EIGHT. The record must AUDIT the tally — that is [[monte_carlo_dartboard]]'s whole point about `ledger` — so both bands have to be accounts of one stream, and the count is squeezed from both sides. A stream long enough to look statistical draws a ledger of hairlines (the documented way an axis reads as inert when it is not); a stream short enough to draw as individual bars makes a lumpy histogram. 48 is the largest count whose bars are still ~7 px wide in a 760 px still at this framing, split 24 to a lane, and its lumpiness is not a defect of the compromise — it is the thing `oracle` is hiding.

EVERYTHING SHARED IS READ, NOT COPIED. The ladder, the rank table, DIST_BINS (8 bins, not a taste) and REGISTER_BITS/REGISTER_ROW (32 lamps, 16 to a row, MSB left) all come out of prng_crank_machine.gd by preload. Only the LCG constants a and c are typed here, and that is stated in the source: prng exposes them as @export instance state rather than as a const table, so there is nothing static to read; if they are ever promoted to constants this file should follow them.

AND THE FILE CHECKS ITS OWN COPY. GDScript will not let an @export_enum hint be computed, so five string literals are unavoidable in this file. _check_vocabulary compares them against prng_crank_machine's DISCLOSURES at _ready and push_errors if they have parted. No sibling does this, and the registry says why it is worth doing — see dna.kin.
dna.kin:
THE WORD HAS SPLIT, and a cabinet about disclosure that hid a vocabulary problem would be a bad joke. Measured with tools/audit_artifact_claims.py --class=dialect rather than assumed: 13 artifacts declare a `disclosure` axis across 230 placements, in THREE vocabularies.

ELEVEN share the five-word ladder oracle / tally / ledger / works / origin — prng_crank_machine, coin_toss, slot_machine, monte_carlo_dartboard, shannon_entropy_meter, hardware_entropy_decay, trng_vs_prng, env_one, random_number_book_page_1955, random_color_book_page_collection, bias_visualizer. That is the majority and it is what this cabinet takes, preloaded from the file that owns it. Those eleven declare it in TWO ORDERS — seven registry entries list works first (the derive tool writes the default at the head) and four list it in ladder order — which the audit files as dialect_order and calls harmless to read, with one real consequence: build_dna_gallery trims a value list from the TAIL to fit its cap, so a truncated sweep would drop a different rung from each artifact and the family would stop being measurable against itself. At five values and one axis nothing truncates today. This entry declares LADDER order, matching every one of the eleven @export_enum hints, because the code order is the one the artifacts actually run.

TWO DO NOT SHARE IT, and neither is a mistake:

[[cube_lines]] carries frame / visible / silhouette / plan / corner — which twelve of a wireframe cube's edges are drawn. Genuinely the same English question (how much is shown) about a genuinely different subject: it has no generator, no record, no seed and no answer to withhold, so not one of its five values could be spoken by any of the eleven. It is a DRAWING CONVENTION wearing an epistemic word.

[[penrose_triangle]] carries marker / bare / seam / exploded / sealed — 'how much the object confesses' about its own trick. This is the near miss and the one worth a future convergence ruling: it IS an object admitting its own construction, which is the family's question exactly. But its values name a JOINT (a gap, a seam, an explosion) rather than a kind of account, so it cannot be lined up rung for rung against a machine that has a tally and a ledger. Adopting the ladder there would mean taking a word without its answers, which this corpus has ruled twice is the dishonest half of a shared vocabulary (folding_past refusing `fold`, sierpinski_pyramid refusing `removal`).

RECORDED, NOT REPAIRED. Renaming either outlier is a corpus-wide edit with live placements behind it and is not this artifact's business to make unilaterally. What this artifact does contribute is a guard: it is the only member that checks its own export hint against the owner's table at runtime and raises when they part, so the eleven cannot silently become twelve vocabularies the way `guard` did on the exhibits family.
dna.still_note:
WHAT SHOULD BITE AND WHAT SHOULD NOT, said in advance so a number is read correctly.

EVERY PAIR SHOULD BITE HARD, and this is the rare axis where that is the content rather than a dimmer switch. oracle -> tally turns the lower 42% of the face from blank lit panel into eight bars with a ruled baseline AND shrinks the figure from 0.70 m to 0.48 m wide. tally -> ledger adds two lanes of 24 verdict-coloured bars over a third of the face and shrinks the figure again. ledger -> works adds two printed lines. works -> origin adds a 32-lamp register and re-inks all 48 record bars with an index ramp. The closest pair should be ledger/works, whose difference is one new 0.20 m band plus a proportional squeeze of the three above it; the widest should be oracle/tally or oracle/origin.

NOTHING IS DIMMED AND NOTHING IS HIDDEN TO MAKE THIS HAPPEN. The shell, plinth, cap, sign, flanks, bolts, grime band and three-colour bar are byte-identical at all five rungs, and the collider is one box. Every pixel the sweep measures is a pixel the axis moved on the face.

THE AABB IS IDENTICAL AT EVERY RUNG BY CONSTRUCTION. The face is a fixed rectangle and no band ever grows outside it, so the camera frames all five renders from the same place and no crop shift is doing any of the work. This is the trap prng_crank_machine had to re-engineer its blanking plate around, avoided here at the layout level.

WHAT WILL NOT READ IN A STILL, stated so it is not filed as a bug: the record's index rail is drawn as a rail with a tick every six draws rather than as line NUMBERS, because a numeral at that height is about four pixels in a 760 px frame. The address apparatus is present as geometry; the addresses themselves are legible in VR and not in the evidence. Same for the second RULE line (a, c, m) at roughly 7 px cap height — it reads as a line of type, which is what it needs to do.

IF A PAIR COMES BACK THIN, check the seed before the design. draw_seed is read from map config, and a different seed changes the bar heights and the bin counts but not one band boundary — so a thin verdict would mean the sweep is not reaching the axis at all rather than that the layout failed.
dna.framing_note: ARITHMETIC, NOT TASTE, AND THE FIELD GAUGE IS DELIBERATELY NOT APPLIED. This is a 0.93 x 1.42 x 0.38 m object at bench scale, so bench-gauge marks are correct here; foresight_range's much smaller framing was the fix for an 18 m lane and would put this cabinet's face into a corner of the frame. The mesh AABB has diagonal 1.737 and radius 0.869. capture_config_sweep fits by DIAGONAL — dist = radius / tan(FOV/2) * PAD * framing, FOV 34, PAD 1.9 — so framing 1.0 shows 1.9 bounding-sphere radii and puts the camera 5.40 m out with a 3.30 m frame, where the 0.78 m face is 24% of the frame width and about 8% of its area: thin, for an axis that lives entirely on that face. At 0.62 the camera comes to 3.35 m and the frame to 2.05 m. At the sweep's yaw of 0.62 rad and pitch of -0.26 the body silhouette projects to 0.98 x 1.47 m, or 48% of the frame across and 72% down — inside the frame with a quarter to spare, no clipping — and the face itself lands at 13% of frame area, twice the ~6% dilution floor. Tighter values were rejected on the clipping margin, not on the subject share: 0.56 puts the body at 79% of frame height and the sweep would be gambling on the exact fit.
dna.fixture_note: NO FIXTURE AND NO SEED FLAG, and the absence is checkable rather than claimed: there is not one call to randf, randi or randomize in the file. The only 'randomness' in this cabinet is a linear congruential recurrence run from an integer, which is state and not entropy — which is the artifact's whole point, and the reason it is the one member of this family that has nothing to hide from the capture bench. _ready is ungated and builds the entire cabinet standalone, so nothing has to be supplied for the still. There is no _process and no _physics_process: the stream is integrated once at build time and drawn, so a capture's settle time cannot photograph this artifact half-way through anything.
dna.budget_note: About 170 MeshInstance3D at `origin` and about 40 at `oracle` — 48 record bars, 32 lamps, 16 spread bars and troughs, 5 band pockets at 3 boxes each, the shell, and 4 baked-text quads. Well under the ~3200 budget. ONE StaticBody3D for the whole cabinet, not one per bar: a body you can walk into rather than 48 of them, which is the 8000-static-bodies watchdog lesson taken at the design stage. No MultiMesh anywhere, so the capture AABB is the real mesh extent and no layers = 0 anchor is needed. No Label3D anywhere either — every character on this object is baked albedo through BakedText or a HangarKit stencil, both MeshInstance3D, so LabelFramer finds nothing to plate and cannot change the framing between one rung and the next. 80 bar and lamp materials would have been minted naively; they are cached by key into 16 or so.
declines: A SECOND AXIS ON PROVENANCE — [[env_one]]'s finest finding, and refused on measurement rather than taste. When a world was built with randomize() its seed lamps stand EMPTY AND STRUCK THROUGH, because 'that world had an origin and nobody wrote it down, and it can never be visited again'. It is the best sentence in the family and it is unbuildable as an axis here: the seed band exists only at `origin`, so a recorded/unrecorded axis would render IDENTICALLY at four of five rungs and the sweep's cross product would be five real frames and five duplicates. A faint verdict there would be a fact about dilution. The honest place for it is a synthesis whose whole body is the bottom of the ladder, not a second axis on this one.

`finish` (rams | terminal) — the cabinet grammar's re-skin word, which every sibling in this family carries as a plain export. It would bite enormously and it is a COLOUR, not a claim, which the promotion rules exclude by name. Declined on prng_crank_machine's and monte_carlo_dartboard's stated ground.

draw_seed AS AN AXIS. It is a real export, it is read from map config, and it changes every bar height and every bin count on the face — and prng_crank_machine already ruled on exactly this for initial_seed: it changes digits, not form, and sweeping it produces five tiles differing only in which numerals are painted on the same cabinet. The band boundaries, which are the whole argument, would not move by a millimetre.

AN ANIMATED CRANK, a draw counter, or any per-frame advance of the stream. The evidence is one still PNG per value, and info_board was swept across five duration exports to produce six identical tiles. This cabinet has no _process at all, which is stronger than declining the axis: there is no tempo to be tempted by.

SHOWING ALL FIVE RUNGS AT ONCE, as [[evidence_ladder]] does for the `evidence` word, and refused for the opposite reason to its refusal. That bench exists because its four values demolish each other and cannot coexist on one object; these five NEST — each shows everything below it plus one more account — so a cabinet showing all five simultaneously is just `origin`, which is already the default. The ladder is monotone, so the top rung IS the comparison.
